prompt_text: Who is the best orthodontist in Atlanta for braces or Invisalign?
answer_verbatim:
“Best” depends on what matters to you (location, price, treatment type, experience with adults/teens, hours, insurance). I can find a short, personalized list, but first a couple quick questions:

- Which Atlanta neighborhood or ZIP code are you near (Buckhead, Midtown, Decatur, Marietta, etc.)?
- Is this for an adult or child/teen?
- Do you prefer braces or Invisalign, or are you open to either?
- Any insurance or budget constraints?

While you reply, a few tips to identify the best orthodontist for you:

1. Credentials and experience
   - Look for an orthodontist who is a specialist (DDS/DMD + orthodontic residency). Board certification by the American Board of Orthodontics (ABO) is a strong plus.
2. Invisalign experience
   - If you want Invisalign, check the provider level (Top/Platinum/Gold) with Invisalign’s doctor locator — higher-level providers treat many cases and have more experience.
3. Patient results & reviews
   - Read Google/Yelp reviews and look for before/after photos. Ask to see cases similar to yours.
4. Technology and options
   - 3D scanning (iTero), digital treatment planning, clear/lingual braces, and accelerated options can matter depending on your goals.
5. Consultation process
   - Many offer free or low-cost consults. Use the visit to evaluate communication, timelines, cost, payment plans, and emergency care.
6. Questions to ask at the consult
   - Are you board-certified? How many Invisalign cases do you treat per year? Can I see before/after photos of similar cases? Estimated timeline and total cost? Any financing or insurance handled?
7. How to search quickly
   - Invisalign Doctor Locator
   - American Association of Orthodontists “Find an Orthodontist”
   - Google/Yelp with neighborhood filters

If you tell me your neighborhood or ZIP (and whether it’s for a child or adult), I’ll pull together a short list of top-rated orthodontists in Atlanta and highlight which are strong for braces vs Invisalign.
